scripts.git:auto: npm run git:add && npm run git:commit && npm run git:push:Main
scripts.git:push:auto: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); let branch = 'Main'; try { branch = execSync('git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD').toString().trim() || branch; } catch(e) {} execSync('git add -A'); try { execSync('git commit -m \"auto: push\"'); } catch(e) {} execSync('git push origin ' + branch, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
